geminiAllowed.title: Allow Gemini cloud chat
geminiAllowed.description: When false, Cortex never sends anything to Gemini. Cloud chat is turned off and locked for the user.

blockedDomains.title: Blocked domains
blockedDomains.description: Hostnames (and their subdomains) that Cortex must never index. Added to the user's own blocklist.

allowedDomainsOnly.title: Allowed domains only
allowedDomainsOnly.description: When non-empty, Cortex indexes only these hostnames (and their subdomains).

retentionDays.title: Retention in days
retentionDays.description: Delete indexed pages, chunks and visits older than this many days. Minimum 1.

indexingDisabled.title: Disable indexing
indexingDisabled.description: When true, Cortex stops indexing pages. Search over existing data still works.

imageDescriptionsAllowed.title: Allow on-device image descriptions
imageDescriptionsAllowed.description: When false, Cortex never generates image descriptions, even on device.
